verdict.rationale: Marlin's docs say it generates a fully referenced report and PowerPoint slides, so there is some common-format output (PPT slides plus a report document). Nothing shows a user-controlled export choice, and the report's file format is never named. missing for 10: spreadsheet export (CSV/XLSX), reference-manager export (BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), a documented document format (PDF/DOCX) or format selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
